facts.fact: BCEAO's communique of 2 April 2026 requires UMOA banks, e-money institutions, payment institutions and microfinance institutions supervised by the Banking Commission, in the Union including Niger, to connect to the PI-SPI instant payment platform and serve customers by 30 June 2026.
